title: EP-Governance Risk Assessment
description: Schema for a single risk-domain assessment evaluating the risk of a transition within a specific domain.

risk_increment.description: The incremental risk this transition adds to the domain.

inherent_risk.description: The inherent risk score before any mitigation credit.

mitigation_credit.description: The risk reduction credit from applicable mitigations.

residual_risk.description: The residual risk score after applying mitigation credit (inherent_risk - mitigation_credit).

threshold.description: The risk threshold for this domain against which residual risk is compared.

decision.description: The risk decision based on comparing residual risk to the threshold.

accepted_by.description: XID of the principal that accepted the risk. Null if not accepted.

accepted_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of risk acceptance. Null if not accepted.

expiration.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this risk acceptance expires. Null if no expiration.

evidence_type.description: Type of evidence supporting the mitigation (e.g., test_result, review_record, control_verification).

evidence_uri.description: URI pointing to the evidence artifact.

evidence_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the evidence artifact, prefixed with 'sha256:'.

verified_by.description: XID of the principal that verified the mitigation evidence.

verified_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the mitigation was verified.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the mitigation credit expires.

scope.description: Scope of the mitigation (e.g., specific resources, actions, or domains it applies to).

credit.description: The risk reduction credit granted by this mitigation.
